title: An improved local score may omit consequences outside the test
text: The essay contrasts well-bounded, replayable environments with open organisational settings in which objectives conflict and state is incomplete. A locally successful output can still create work or harm elsewhere. Evaluation should therefore seek feedback from the people receiving the result, not only from the producing agent.
qualification: Speculative analysis represented in supplied notes; no particular product or workflow is claimed to exhibit this failure.
